Status: proposed by the content plan; the instructional rationale is in 04-content-plan.md.

exceptions.rationale: Automaticity is a timing behaviour that selected response cannot show. Three adult-run quick-read rounds replace the fifteen.
Oral reading accuracy on unfamiliar text is measured by listening: three dated timed readings.
Phrasing and expression are heard, not selected: three rehearse-and-perform rounds with the adult checklist.
A child's own self-correction happens only while reading aloud: three adult-observed rounds plus the fix-up log.
Cursive letter formation is a motor skill: trace, then write, in three sessions with the adult checklist.
Spacing in cursive is a motor skill: three dictated-sentence sessions with the adult checklist.
